plan.note: What the subscription actually costs, for the multiple. Not derived from tokens.

counterfactual.note: Every cache read and cache write repriced as fresh input at the same model and rate.

unpriced.note: No rate published in the rate card. Counted, never priced, never zeroed.

excluded.note: Generated locally without an API call. Never billed.
